generation.entry_policy: every prior entry_id must remain present byte-for-byte through its content-addressed identifier

authority.note: The floor is local anti-rollback custody. It does not admit a tuple, create compatibility evidence, or authorize game effects.

limitations: the floor protects only callers that require and verify it
the floor is not distributed consensus
the floor does not defend against compromise of the owning account or root
registry entry removal requires an explicit future revocation schema rather than silent rollback
relocating the floor requires preserving its exact owner-private custody and content
